Nobody talks about how Jacob walked away. 🌙

He wrestled until daybreak, lost his hip to one touch, and still said: “I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.” He got a new name that night. And then “the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.” Blessed and limping.

What are you wrestling with God about? One word 👇
